page: UpCloud PREMIUM-8xCPU-64GB is a Premium family virtual server running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 8 shared vCPUs mapped to 8 physical cores of an AMD EPYC 9575F processor clocked at 2.0 GHz. The system is equipped with 64.0 GB of RAM, providing 8.0 GB of memory per core, alongside 300 GB of local SSD storage and one complimentary public IPv4 address. The x86_64 architecture supports advanced instruction sets including AVX-512, vector neural network instructions, and cryptography standards like AES and SHA_NI.

Benchmark data indicates top-tier single-core CPU performance, with single-core stress-ng tests, single-threaded gzip compression, and single-threaded bzip3 decompression scoring in the top 10% of tested systems. Multi-core CPU performance, database operations, and static web serving throughput fall into the average tier. However, memory write bandwidth for large uncached blocks and overall PassMark memory scores are positioned in the bottom 25%, indicating a potential bottleneck for write-heavy memory operations.

Given its 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this server offers a memory-optimized hardware profile. It delivers strong single-threaded execution and high memory capacity without the cost of dedicated CPU allocations, as it utilizes shared CPU resources. This configuration is well-suited for memory-intensive workloads that do not require continuous maximum multi-core utilization, such as caching layers, relational database hosting, web serving, and lightweight text processing.
